name: containers-compose
description: Docker Compose files for all 3 container variants (deb-nix, deb-apt, nixos-hm)
_doc_private_repos: Repos that must NEVER be cloned at image build time. Every image here publishes to a PUBLIC GHCR namespace, so a private repo baked into a layer is published to anyone who pulls - and the layer keeps it even if a later step deletes the directory. Injecting a token to make the clone succeed is strictly worse: same exposure, plus the token can land in a layer. Private content is cloned at RUNTIME with an injected deploy key. build.sh fails the build if a src Containerfile names any of these, so the mistake cannot ship again (it shipped twice: Containerfile.deb-nix and Containerfile.deb-apt both cloned cloud-data into public images).
